patch.value: GH-714: linked-test verbose child stdout still aborts with EAGAIN after bounded-drain fix

The published bounded linked-test output drain still allows a verbose Bun child to abort while the identical quality command passes directly. Reproduce below the disclosed capture cap, distinguish transport backpressure from assertion failure, keep pipes draining through child completion, and preserve bounded disclosed output.

A deterministic verbose-child regression reproduces the released EAGAIN path without excessive fixture output; Linked tests continuously drain child pipes through completion while bounding retained and disclosed output; Transport truncation and failures are classified separately from product assertion failures; Node and Bun subprocess acceptance plus full repository gates pass
